pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā bhikkhunī Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ upasaṃkamitvā etad avoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:1.5: sādhū 'ti paṭisuṇitvā n' eva vūpasameti na vūpasamāya ussukkaṃ karoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:1.6: atha kho sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā Thullanandā bhikkhuniyā
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:1.9: eh' ayye imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasamehīti vuccamānā
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:1.10: sādhū 'ti paṭisuṇitvā n' eva vūpasamessati na vūpasamāya ussukkaṃ karissatīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:1.21.1: yā pana bhikkhunī bhikkhuniyā eh' ayye imaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasamehīti vuccamānā sādhū 'ti paṭisuṇitvā sā pacchā anantarāyikinī n' eva vūpasameyya na vūpasamāya ussukkaṃ kareyya, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:2.1.8: cattāri adhikaraṇāni vivādādhikaraṇaṃ anuvādādhikaraṇaṃ āpattādhikaraṇaṃ kiccādhikaraṇaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:2.1.17: n' eva vūpasamessāmi na vūpasamāya ussukkaṃ karissāmīti dhuraṃ nikkhittamatte āpatti pācittiyassa. ||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:2.2.1: upasampannāya upasampannasaññā adhikaraṇaṃ n' eva vūpasameti na vūpasamāya ussukkaṃ karoti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc45:2.2.4: anupasampannāya adhikaraṇaṃ n' eva vūpasameti na vūpasamāya ussukkaṃ karoti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
